title: US stocks end sharply lower; Middle East turmoil fans inflation fear
title_zh: 美股大幅收低；中东动荡加剧通胀担忧
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended sharply lower on Friday, with the Dow dropping nearly one percent, the S&P 500 falling one-and-a-half percent to close at it lowest level in six months, and the Nasdaq shedding two percent, nearing correction territory.The small-cap Russ...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周五大幅收低，其中道琼斯指数下跌近百分之一，标准普尔 500 指数下跌百分之半，收于六个月以来的最低水平，纳斯达克指数下跌百分之二，接近回调区域。

title: Market Madness: Palantir, Walmart, & other hot stock picks
title_zh: 市场疯狂：Palantir、沃尔玛和其他热门股票精选
summary: In the second installment of Yahoo Finance's "Market Madness" bracket tournament, Zack's Investment Management chief market strategist Brian Mulberry joins Yahoo Finance Head of News Myles Udland to make the case for this round of corporate match-ups, which includes Robinhood ...
summary_zh: 在雅虎财经“市场疯狂”分组赛的第二期中，扎克投资管理公司首席市场策略师布莱恩·穆伯里 (Brian Mulberry) 与雅虎财经新闻主管迈尔斯·乌德兰 (Myles Udland) 一起为这一轮企业对决进行论证，其中包括 Robinhood ...

title: How to navigate uncertain markets during the Iranian conflict
title_zh: 如何在伊朗冲突期间驾驭不确定的市场
summary: Morningstar Wealth CIO of the Americas, Philip Straehl, joins Yahoo Finance Head of News Myles Udland to break down the stagflationary shock hitting markets (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) and why portfolio diversification appears to be getting more challenging for investors.
summary_zh: 晨星财富美洲首席信息官 Philip Straehl 与雅虎财经新闻主管 Myles Udland 一起分析了市场遭受的滞胀冲击（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC），以及为什么投资组合多元化似乎对投资者来说变得更具挑战性。

title: Supermicro stock plunges 33% after US charges co-founder with conspiracy to smuggle Nvidia chips to China
title_zh: 美国指控联合创始人串谋将 Nvidia 芯片走私到中国后，超微股价暴跌 33%
summary: Supermicro stock plummeted after an unsealed indictment revealed that the US charged two Supermicro employees and a contractor with smuggling servers containing Nvidia chips to China.
summary_zh: 在一份未密封的起诉书披露美国指控两名超微员工和一名承包商向中国走私含有英伟达芯片的服务器后，超微股价暴跌。

title: Roblox to overhaul ad policies, introduce revenue sharing in 2027
title_zh: Roblox 将彻底改革广告政策，并于 2027 年引入收入分成
summary: Videogame platform Roblox said on Friday it would take a portion of revenue from in-game brand deals starting next ‌year, as part of a broader advertising-policy overhaul designed to draw ‌in more brand dollars and increase creator earnings.
summary_zh: 视频游戏平台 Roblox 周五表示，从明年开始，它将从游戏内品牌交易中抽取一部分收入，作为更广泛的广告政策改革的一部分，旨在吸引更多品牌资金并增加创作者收入。

title: Super Micro co-founder's smuggling arrest, Planet Labs stock soars
title_zh: Super Micro联合创始人走私被捕，Planet Labs股价飙升
summary: Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman takes a look at some of Friday morning's trending tickers and stories. FedEx (FDX) earnings beat Wall Street's estimates on the top and bottom lines. The company also lifted its full-year guidance.
summary_zh: 市场催化剂主持人朱莉·海曼 (Julie Hyman) 回顾了周五上午的一些热门行情和故事。联邦快递（FDX）的盈利超出了华尔街的顶线和底线预期。该公司还上调了全年指引。

title: The robotaxi companies have the same goal but wildly different problems
title_zh: 机器人出租车公司有着相同的目标，但问题却截然不同
summary: The top players in the space, from Uber, to Alphabet's Waymo, to Tesla, all face technological roadblocks even as they must clear obstacles unique to their respective brands and operations.
summary_zh: 从 Uber 到 Alphabet 旗下的 Waymo，再到特斯拉，该领域的顶尖企业都面临着技术障碍，尽管他们必须清除各自品牌和运营所特有的障碍。

title: Morning Brief: Deescalation hopes amid surging oil
title_zh: 早间简报：油价飙升带来局势缓和的希望
summary: We've got an empty economic and corporate calendar, leaving a vacuum for the ups and downs of the oil market. The key thing to watch for: signs of deescalation.
summary_zh: 我们的经济和企业日历空空荡荡，为石油市场的涨跌留下了真空。需要注意的关键是：降级迹象。

title: Financial stocks on pace for worst first quarter since 2020 as private credit cracks flash 'yellow warning'
title_zh: 由于私人信贷崩溃发出“黄色警告”，金融股将迎来2020年以来最糟糕的第一季度
summary: A string of giants such as BlackRock, Morgan Stanley, and Blackstone have been the latest financial firms to impose redemption limits on private debt funds as investor anxiety builds.
summary_zh: 随着投资者焦虑情绪的加剧，贝莱德、摩根士丹利和黑石等一系列巨头成为最新对私人债务基金实施赎回限制的金融公司。
